stemMd: A chart lists laboratory electricity use of 800 kWh in April and 920 kWh in May. The number of tests rises from 400 to 500. Which statement is correct?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Electricity use per test stayed at 2 kWh.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Electricity use per test increased because total use rose.

options.label: E
options.textMd: May used less electricity in total.

explanationMd: April used 800/400 = 2 kWh per test; May used 920/500 = 1.84 kWh per test. The per-test figure fell even though the total rose. The denominator grew proportionally more than the numerator.

distractorRationale.c: Total use alone ignores the larger test count.
distractorRationale.e: The total increased from 800 to 920 kWh.
